	uniqueStateTypeNames = reduce(lambda re, x: re+[x] if x not in re else re, [state['stateTypeName'] for state in stateEvents], [])

	uniqueAssetNames = reduce(lambda re, x: re+[x] if x not in re else re, [state['assetName'] for state in stateEvents], [])
	summaryByAssetData = [{'name': name, 'stateDurationSecs': sum(stateEvent['stateDurationSecs'] for stateEvent in stateEvents if stateEvent['assetName'] == name and stateEvent['stateTypeName'] != 'Running')} for name in uniqueAssetNames]
	summaryByAssetData = sorted(summaryByAssetData, key=lambda x: x['stateDurationSecs'], reverse = True)
	assetNameColorList = defaultColorList
	summaryByAsset = {'data': summaryByAssetData, 'series': [entry['stateDurationSecs'] for entry in summaryByAssetData], 'labels': [entry['name'] for entry in summaryByAssetData], 'colors': assetNameColorList}
	
	summary = {'byStateName': summaryByStateName, 'byStateType': summaryByStateType, 'byAsset': summaryByAsset}
